portal_gest.sin_pedidos_recepcion: There are no orders pending receipt (shipped or partial).
portal_gest.sec_licitaciones_desc: Reverse auctions (RFQ): request a price from your suppliers and award the best offer.
portal_gest.vas_a_vincular: You are about to link the supplier reference {r} to the item that ALREADY EXISTS in your internal catalog:
portal_gest.asociar_recepcion_desc: Link a goods receipt to an invoice, with the corresponding amount (`db.compras.asociar_recepcion_factura`) — for invoices that group several receipts.
portal_gest.aviso_sin_recepcion: This order does not yet have goods received at the warehouse (received from Logistics). The landed cost can still be recorded, but it will only be reflected in the item's average cost once the goods are received.
portal_gest.equivalencia_registrada: Equivalence with the supplier reference registered successfully.
portal_gest.codigo_generado_automatico: The item code (EAN-13) is generated automatically on save — it reuses the same generator as the desktop application, and is never typed by hand.
portal_gest.sec_calidad_desc: Summary of inspections, non-conformities, and CAPA.
portal_gest.costes_prorrateo_desc: They are apportioned over the average cost of the items in the chosen receipt, according to the chosen allocation method (by quantity, value, or weight).
portal_gest.unidades_merma_calidad_lbl: Units of loss associated with quality:
portal_gest.homologar_desc: The "commercial status" is your approval as a company (discounts/terms/blocking). "Identity verification (KYB)" is the check of the supplier's company name/tax ID on the platform — it is shared with the other companies that work with them.
portal_gest.base_calcula_ph: calculated if left empty and there is an order
portal_gest.tramo_alcanzado_detalle: Tier reached: from {d} € → {p} % (estimated rebate {r} €, not yet settled)
portal_gest.solicitar_aprobacion_btn: Request approval (if it exceeds the configured threshold)
portal_gest.sin_costes_landed: No extra costs apportioned yet on these lines.
portal_gest.sec_devoluciones_desc: Record and view returns to supplier.
portal_gest.confirmar_adjudicar_js: Award this offer and generate the B2B Order?
portal_gest.sin_proveedor_precio_negociado: No supplier has a currently valid negotiated price for this item.
portal_gest.sec_incidencias_desc: Damaged, missing, excess, rejection… and their resolution.
portal_gest.comparativa_desc: Compare the negotiated price, rating, and lead time of suppliers offering an item.
portal_gest.sec_recepciones_desc: Orders pending receipt or partially received.
portal_gest.calidad_solo_lectura_desc: Read-only view. The full Quality module (inspections, non-conformities, CAPA, audits) is managed from the Smart Manager desktop app.
portal_gest.sin_licitaciones: No tenders have been created yet.
portal_gest.abono_desc: A credit note cancels (fully or partially) the amount of an already registered invoice; a corrective invoice corrects it. It is recorded as its own document (`db.compras.registrar_abono`).
portal_gest.sin_tramos_rappel_ningun_proveedor: No supplier has rebate tiers configured yet.
portal_gest.sec_compras_pro_desc: Recurring orders, blanket orders, supplier comparison, and order approval.
portal_gest.aprobacion_desc: Orders exceeding the configured threshold require approval (Workflow circuit).
portal_gest.sec_rappels_desc: Accumulated rebate tiers by supplier and settlement.
portal_gest.sin_lineas_pendientes_recibir: There are no lines left to receive on this order.
portal_gest.categoria_opc_lbl: Category (optional if you specify an item)
portal_gest.sin_proveedores: No suppliers have been registered yet.
portal_gest.buscar_articulo_desc: Check before creating a new one: search by code or name in your catalog AND in your suppliers' catalogs (items from your catalog always appear first and highlighted).
portal_gest.sec_informes_desc: Spend by supplier, by period, and by item.
portal_gest.permite_que_al_recibir: allows the system to automatically recognize goods received from this supplier — when scanning THEIR own barcode — as this internal item.
portal_gest.contratos_vencen: {n} contract(s) expire in the next 60 days.
portal_gest.etiqueta_sin_impresora: The label could not be sent to any configured printer — the label PDF is still available in the Document Center.
portal_gest.no_completo_alta: — (did not complete sign-up on the Supplier Portal)
portal_gest.sec_alta_articulo_desc: Create a new item in the internal catalog (automatic EAN-13) and, optionally, link it to a supplier reference.
portal_gest.etiqueta_generada_impresa: Label generated (internal ref. + retail price + section) and sent to the configured printer.
portal_gest.codigo_articulo_opc_lbl: Item code (optional if you specify a category)
portal_gest.orden_abierta_desc: Total quantity agreed with the supplier; consumed (called off) in partial orders.
portal_gest.costes_prorrateo_b2b_desc: They are apportioned over the average cost of the items in this B2B order, according to the chosen allocation method (by quantity, value, or weight).
portal_gest.gestion_compras_desc: Supplier back office: approval, issues, returns, receipts, invoices, contracts, reports, and the Quality summary.
portal_gest.sin_tramos_proveedor: No tiers configured for this supplier.
portal_gest.no_se_creara_articulo: No new item will be created — only the equivalence, so that when receiving goods from this supplier by scanning their own barcode, the system recognizes it as this item.
portal_gest.pedido_recurrente_desc: Automatically generates an order every N days (background job, already active).
portal_gest.licitaciones_desc: Request a price from your approved suppliers for an item or category: each supplier bids blind (never seeing the others' offers). When the auction closes —manually from here, or automatically when the deadline expires— the best offer becomes a real B2B Order, with the same funds custody and status cycle as any other order.
portal_gest.equivalencias_desc: Each row links a supplier reference to this internal item. «Undo» does NOT delete the history — it just stops being recognized at reception and in search; you can reactivate it later if it was a mistake.
portal_gest.sin_equivalencias: This item does not have any supplier mapping yet.
portal_gest.buscar_articulo_desc2: Check before creating a new one: search by code or name in your internal catalog. If an item has several supplier mappings, they're all listed, with the most recent one in bold.
portal_gest.confirmar_deshacer_js: Undo this mapping? It will stop being recognized at reception and in search; you can reactivate it later.
portal_gest.es_complementario_lbl: Complementary item (counts as a "cross-sell" when sold via POS)
portal_gest.es_promocional_lbl: Promotional item (counts as a "promo sale" when sold via POS)
